name: Champ de Mars Racecourse
subtitle: A racecourse in the centre of Port Louis, where horse racing began in 1812 on a former military training ground.

facts.label: Oldest in southern hemisphere
facts.value: Le Mauricien calls it the first racecourse of the southern hemisphere.

facts.label: Purpose
facts.value: Governor Farquhar organised races to bring English and French communities together; the site was a former French military training ground.

facts.label: Club ranking (disputed)
facts.value: AFP: the club is 'believed to be the third oldest racing club in the world'; other web sources say second. Do not state a world rank.

parts.text: A racecourse in the centre of Port Louis, where horse racing began in 1812 on a former military training ground. It is home to the Mauritius Turf Club.
